fixture_name: Ramp-terminal arterial reconstruction — US preliminary design (MassDOT HSIP municipal RSA, full package)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Ramp-terminal pedestrian crossings with no delineation/ADA ramps, sight-line obstruction by vegetation, and a non-compliant four-lane high-speed mid-block crossing with a prior fatality are core, high-severity preliminary-design RSA issues for an interchange context.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal separation-failure mechanism is backed by a verbatim quote (EV-US-030) and the treatment duty by EV-US-032, while site specifics are anchored to recorded sample-report observations (Safety Issue #4) with no invented content.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: FHWA-SA-06-06 lineage semantics are respected: the finding remains a safety concern grounded in crash mechanism and exposure, with MUTCD/ADA elements serving the safety argument rather than converting it into a standalone compliance question.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific, phased, and viable: immediate MUTCD signage, ADA ramps and crosswalk designation within the current design, future signalized ramp crossings, and relocation of the mid-block crossing to the Derby Shoppes signal via a sidewalk extension.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians are explicitly identified as the directly exposed vulnerable user group with driver attention-diversion also considered, fully addressing VRU impacts relevant to ramp and mid-block crossings.

justifications.substance: Undefined lane drop with abrupt striping termination, absent advance signage, and observed late merges at an interchange ramp mouth is a substantive driver-expectancy/decision-load safety issue squarely within preliminary-design RSA scope.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim that the lane reduction is unsigned and poorly delineated is supported by a verbatim quote in EV-US-033; the observed late-merge behavior is presented as a recorded field observation from Safety Issue #2 rather than invented content, though it lacks its own direct quotation.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as a safety_concern with no compliance assertion; the generic FHWA RSA purpose quote (EV-US-023) frames scope appropriately, and the design/signing remedy stays within safety-improvement semantics rather than claiming regulatory violation.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: advance merge signage plus pavement markings located ahead of the NB on-ramp entrance, with a viable alternative (extend two lanes past the ramp, sign the mandatory right-turn trade-off) carried into the ongoing reconstruction design; not a null recommendation.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrian exposure at the adjacent mid-block crosswalk is explicitly acknowledged and cross-referenced to JB-GF12-001, while the vehicle-to-vehicle merge conflict mechanism here justifies scoping road_users to drivers; not applicable but acknowledged scores 1.
